requirements.title: Extensibility excludes BIND, SEQUENCE and the two intrinsic C pointer types
requirements.source: 7.5.7.1 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF104, printed90, lines3-4.
requirements.definition: A derived type is extensible when it is neither C_PTR nor C_FUNPTR from intrinsic ISO_C_BINDING and has neither BIND nor SEQUENCE. These are exclusions by actual type/attribute, not by a guessed layout or the local spelling of an identifier. Extensible means eligible for extension; it does not mean already extended. C737 and C705 own the corresponding EXTENDS and CLASS admission restrictions.

requirements.title: EXTENDS identifies the extended type and its immediate parent
requirements.definition: A type bearing EXTENDS is an extended type, and its parent is the type named in that EXTENDS type-attribute specification. A parent is immediate; a more remote ancestor is reached recursively, not selected arbitrarily from the ancestry chain. The name may be a local USE rename, but renaming does not change the selected entity.

pending.prior-parent-source-use: PENDING — Source-use: C737 owns previously-defined/type/extensible eligibility, and R728 owns the EXTENDS(parent-type-name) form. Preserve existing forward/nontype/ordinary parent cases and repairs; this defining paragraph does not introduce another rejection execution.

pending.immediate-versus-ancestor-source-use: PENDING — Source-use: the single ancestry matrix under S7.5.7.1-003 and recursive component paths under S7.5.7.2-004 distinguish immediate parent from indirect ancestor. These are planned S-owned runtime sources; no supported link or duplicate program is asserted.

requirements.oracle: This is a definition/source-use wrapper. The inspected renamed-parent control has an exact inherited-value observation, but only its original ownership is credited. Immediate-parent and component-name observations have separately identified future owners.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Do not infer the parent-component spelling from a successful inherited-field access. A type is not its immediate parent merely because extension is reflexive; root types have no parent.

requirements.title: Extension is reflexive and follows the recursive parent relation
requirements.definition: An extensible type without EXTENDS is an extension type only of itself. An extended type is an extension of itself and of every type for which its parent is an extension. Thus a child's relation to an ancestor is directional and transitively inherited; siblings are not extensions of one another merely because they share a parent. This relation is not the same as the unary extensibility property or general assignment/argument compatibility, and it is not a claim about identical storage.

pending.kind-and-absent-state-source-use: PENDING — Source-use: 16.9.86 ignores kind parameters, unlike CLASS IS guards, and has ordered unlimited-polymorphic absent-state branches plus a processor-dependent residual branch. Keep those canonical conditions explicit; no such branch is an ancestry witness here. A future PDT contrast may use abstract KIND tags 1 and 2, never intrinsic representation codes, after separate review.

requirements.oracle: One shared matrix M evaluates all25 ordered pairs once using five concrete, nonpointer, nonallocatable extensible objects. Literal expected rows TFFFF/TTFFF/TTTFF/TFFTF/FFFFT are independent of every inquiry result. Direct calls avoid an incompatible CLASS(root) helper for unrelated other. The separate dynamic case passes a live grand actual to CLASS(root), obtains true against a child MOLD, and independently checks that a real root object gives false against the same MOLD. All payloads and local markers are defined by named assignments.
requirements.oracle_limitation: EXTENDS_TYPE_OF requires extensible declared type or unlimited polymorphism, and forbids undefined association status for polymorphic pointers. Nonextensible declared-type objects cannot simply be passed to obtain false; unrestricted wrappers can instead encounter processor-dependent dynamic-type cases. Initial plans use neither pointers nor unlimited polymorphism. No private-SEQUENCE identity assertion.

requirements.title: ABSTRACT defines abstractness independently of a mandatory local deferred member
requirements.definition: An abstract type is a type with ABSTRACT. The attribute does not require a local deferred binding, and an extension is not automatically abstract just because its parent is abstract. C738 supplies the obligation when deferred bindings are contained or inherited; C739 supplies extensibility. Canonical object/type-specifier constraints, not the informative example alone, prevent creating ordinary abstract objects.
